activity.notes: Tribhuvan became King of Nepal in 1911. ATLAS ends the first reign phase on 7 November 1950, when the Rana government attempted to depose him after he sought refuge in the Indian embassy; the exile/deposition interruption is not flattened into a continuous reign.

sources.title: British Museum — Tribhuvan Bir Bikram, King of Nepal
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Tribhuvan as a Shah dynasty king of Nepal who ruled 1911-1955.

sources.title: Nehru Archive — To Rajendra Prasad, 7 November 1950
sources.citation_text: Nehru's contemporary correspondence records the crisis in which King Tribhuvan sought refuge at the Indian embassy in November 1950.
